sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your body is most important for tracking a flying shuttlecock?
When catching a fast-moving ball, what should you do with your hands upon impact?
options: B) Pull them back slightly to absorb the force
questions.answer: B) Pull them back slightly to absorb the force

questions.question_text: What is the most accurate way to kick a soccer ball for a short, controlled pass?
options: A) With the tip of the toes
C) With the inside of the foot
questions.answer: C) With the inside of the foot

questions.question_text: In the 'Little Steps' running drill, how should your feet move?
options: B) Quick, light, and short steps
questions.answer: B) Quick, light, and short steps

questions.question_text: When throwing a ball overhand, which foot should you step forward with?
options: A) The foot on the same side as your throwing arm
C) The foot opposite to your throwing arm
D) You should not step forward
questions.answer: C) The foot opposite to your throwing arm

questions.question_text: Which action is the best example of good eye-hand coordination?
options: A) Running in a straight line

questions.question_text: What is the best body stance for getting ready to receive a thrown ball?
options: A) Standing with legs completely straight and hands in pockets
B) Knees slightly bent, hands up and ready
C) Sitting cross-legged on the ground
D) Turning your back to the thrower
questions.answer: B) Knees slightly bent, hands up and ready

questions.question_text: What happens if you frequently kick a football using only the tip of your toes?
options: A) It is hard to control the direction and can hurt your toes
B) The ball always goes perfectly straight
D) It is the safest way to pass to a teammate
questions.answer: A) It is hard to control the direction and can hurt your toes

questions.question_text: When striking a shuttlecock underhand, where should the racket make contact?
What piece of equipment is primarily used to strike a shuttlecock?
Describe the correct hand position when catching a ball thrown directly at your chest. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Form a triangle or W-shape with your thumbs and index fingers, keeping your fingers spread wide to safely secure and catch the ball.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to swing your arms opposite to your legs while running? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Swinging your arms helps keep your body balanced, maintains a steady rhythm, and gives you more forward power and speed while running.

questions.question_text: Explain the correct body mechanics to perform a powerful overhand throw. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stand sideways, bring your throwing arm back near your ear, step forward with your opposite foot, and release the ball smoothly toward the target.

questions.question_text: What is the best and safest way to stop a rolling soccer ball with your foot? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Watch the ball closely, position your body directly in its path, and gently trap it using the inside or sole of your foot.

questions.question_text: How should you position your body right before preparing to strike a shuttlecock? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your knees slightly bent, hold the racket firmly, watch the shuttlecock closely, and stand balanced on the balls of your feet.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are participating in a relay race. Describe how you will safely pass the baton to your teammate while running. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would run fast toward my teammate while holding the baton firmly. As I get close, I would shout a signal like "Go!" and carefully place the baton into their open hand without slowing down, ensuring neither of us drops it.

questions.question_text: Describe the sequence of body movements you would use to jump over a small hurdle safely during a 'Little Steps' track drill. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, I would take quick, small steps to build steady speed. As I approach the hurdle, I would lift my lead knee high, push off the ground with my back foot, clear the hurdle easily, and land lightly on my toes.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete action of serving a shuttlecock to start a badminton game, ensuring you follow proper sports mechanics. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To serve, I stand behind the service line with my feet comfortably apart. I hold the shuttlecock by its feathers in one hand and the racket in the other. I drop the shuttlecock and use a smooth underhand swing to hit the cork base, sending it high over the net.

questions.question_text: How do you correctly coordinate your eyes, hands, and body to successfully catch a high, flying ball during a field game? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I keep my eyes focused on the ball the entire time it is in the air. I quickly move my feet to get perfectly underneath its path. I reach my hands up, forming a large cup, and gently pull the ball toward my chest as I catch it to absorb the impact.
